messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Add a second groove on the screw head, perpendicular to the existing one and with the same shape and dimensions, so the head becomes a cross-slotted screw.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response:
```json
{
  "match": true,
  "confidence": 1.0,
  "reason": "The edited part successfully adds a second perpendicular groove of the same shape and dimensions to form a cross-slotted screw head while preserving all other features."
}
```
